caption: Table 20-3. Key nutritional factors for foods for young adult cats.
note: 表头原为两行：Factors | Recommended food levels*（下分 Normal weight 与 Inactive/obese prone）。表下注：Key: ME = metabolizable energy, VOHC = Veterinary Oral Health Council (Chapter 47). *Dry matter basis. Concentrations presume an energy density of 4.0 kcal/g. Levels should be corrected for foods with higher energy densities. Adjustment is unnecessary for foods with lower energy densities.
